meta.title: Say hello
meta.description: Contact Happy Paws Cat Rescue about adopting, fostering, fundraising or anything else.

s1.p: We love to hear from our wonderful supporters, so please say “Hello”. Ask us about a cat, about fostering, or anything else.
s1.p2: We reply as soon as we can.

s2.label: First name
s2.label5: What would you like to talk about?
s2.label6: Name of the cat (if you are asking about one)
s2.text: This helps us pass your message to the right person.
s2.label7: Tell us a little about yourself, and the home you could offer if you are asking about a cat
s2.text2: I would like to receive the Happy Paws newsletter.
s2.p: We use your details only to reply to your message. [How we look after your information](/privacy/)
s2.dd2: We have foster homes here too.

list.question: How do I adopt a cat?
list.answer: Choose a cat on our cats page and use the Apply button on their page to fill in our application form. [Read how adoption works](/adopting/).

list.question: Can I volunteer or foster?
list.answer: Yes, we would love to hear from you. [Find out about fostering](/foster/).
